Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Exterior door scroll lever handle. Default hardware for exterior single and double doors.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Mesh3D exported via Na__DevTools::Na__JsonExporter3D on 2026-07-16. Authored lying on back (spindle +Z); builder applies X -90 lay-back plus CorrectionRotZ 180 so the scroll hangs down. ScaleX RH=-1 / LH=1 so levers face the meeting stile. OffsetX is 0 — exterior placement uses HandleAbsoluteX from the meeting stile (UI Handle Position). Has2dPlan/Elevation are false.
